coverage.notes: Sleeping Arona covers puppet rendering, flare/lens layers, particles, alpha-sensitive composition, and existing effect stripping constraints.
Shiroko Night Video covers main embedded video texture playback, particles, effect chain, and decoder timing tolerance.

Spider-Verse covers godrays, shake, pulse, and a prior stale _rt_default presentation artifact. Local probe on 2026-05-27 found the Workshop item installed and structural validation passed with one composelayer warning. Windows WE comparison on 2026-06-07 confirmed the bottom-right-to-center diagonal godray/artifact was absent from Windows reference frames but present in Yakkai; after the generic render-target synchronization fix, human review approved promotion to active deep still coverage.

Alya Clock and Date covers Clock/Date text SceneScript bindings, script property resolution, generated text-layer representation, and user property gating. Local validation now resolves two script-bound text layers with no SceneScript gaps, and human review on 2026-06-07 approved the shoulder/character composition for deep still coverage.

Elaina Day Night Gradient covers non-puppet SceneScript and day-night tint/property behavior with active deep-only Morning, Day, Dusk, Night, and Day Night Gradient smoke variants. Local visual review approved the promoted still baselines; repeated deep smoke passed with expected animated sky/video phase drift covered by the scene threshold.

buckets.name: Overlay Or Small Embedded Video Texture

coverage.notes: Girl and Fluorescent Beach covers embedded mp4 references inside a scene package with active deep-only motion sequence coverage for overlay video/water-effect behavior. Local probe on 2026-05-27 found the Workshop item installed and structural validation passed with one composelayer warning. Human review on 2026-06-07 approved still and motion artifacts for deep baseline promotion.

Cyber City Parkour covers non-puppet models, camera framing, material fallback, composelayers, particle sprite materials, and lights with active deep-only still coverage. Local structural validation now passes with no material-loading warnings after TEXB v4 sprite-header parsing and local composelayer publishing fixes. Human review on 2026-06-07 approved the promoted still baseline.

buckets.name: Wallpaper Engine Web Project And Audio Shim

coverage.notes: CWAV Engine is a WE web project covered by the web harness candidate path. The candidate uses WE viewport globals, authored web properties, and harness-only synthetic audio to validate visible audio-reactive bars; real Linux audio capture remains deferred until a separate PipeWire/PulseAudio design. Local review on 2026-06-09 showed the authored defaults can place the clock and date tightly enough to overlap at the 1280x720 harness size; keep tests on the authored defaults and do not add fixture-only placement overrides. A far-future Plasma settings feature should expose or import WE Web user properties so users can adjust values such as DateY themselves.

Audio Visualizer is active deep-only WE web/audio sequence coverage with canvas visualizer logic, Wallpaper Engine audio listener usage, and harness-only synthetic audio. The active fixture uses PNG sequence capture, generated review clips, motion enforcement, and a wider RMSE band because browser animation timing and visualizer smoothing can shift the exact bar shape between valid runs. Optional live recording is not part of the gate after signal exits were observed in the live recording path.

buckets.name: Wallpaper Engine Web Project With Video Element

coverage.notes: Rain Drops (heavy rain) is active deep-only WE web-video coverage with local video media plus WebGL/canvas rain rendering. It exercises QtWebEngine media loading and visible web animation without requiring user input.

Blue Archive Shiroko Live2D is a plain WE video project covered by the video harness candidate path. Local probing confirmed project.json type video with shiroko.mp4; the 90000ms normal-speed window had the strongest reviewed motion among sampled Shiroko windows, but the source is visually calm and should be treated as decode coverage rather than strong motion coverage.

TIMDRIFT II Mountains/Clouds Timelapse is active deep-only plain WE video motion coverage. The active fixture uses a 90000ms normal-speed sequence that showed stronger motion than Shiroko while still looking like wallpaper-style video rather than a hard scene transition.

promotionCriteria: Candidate is locally installed and still matches the documented project type.
Scene-package candidates pass tools/validate-scene.sh when that tool supports the package.
Candidate artifacts are generated with ./smoke-tests/run.sh --suite deep --write-candidates after it is temporarily added to a non-release run.
Manual review confirms camera angle, visible elements, color balance, composition, effect intensity, and expected motion.
Promoted candidates enter deep first and release only after repeated strict runs are stable.
